steps.title: Prepare Samples and Equipment
steps.instruction: Set centrifuge to 4°C. Ensure all steps are performed on ice unless otherwise stated. Clean micro-scissors with Virkon (immerse 10 mins), wipe on Azo-wipe (laid flat), and air-dry.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Processing
steps.instruction: Prepare a labeled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 500 µL BLP digest buffer. Transfer the biopsies (two 3 mm TI biopsies or three rectum biopsies) into the buffer and cut up with micro-scissors.

steps.title: Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Mechanically break up the tissue using a 1 mL pipette and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Pipette gently 5 times with 1 mL pipette to break up tissue, ensuring all pieces pass into the tip.
Repeat pipetting gently 5 times with 1 mL pipette every ten minutes, ensuring all pieces pass through the tip; return to ice.

steps.title: Enzyme Quenching and Dilution
steps.instruction: Stop the initial dissociation and dilute the sample.

substeps.instruction: At 30 min, add 200 µL 25% BSA to overwhelm the enzyme and pipette gently 5 times with 1 mL pipette to break up remaining chunks.
Top up the tube to 10 mL using ice cold HBSS-/- buffer.

steps.title: First Centrifugation and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample and concentrate the cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 350 g @ 4°C for 5 min.
Pour off supernatant gently (flick the last drop out).
Let the tube stand for a minute, then gently resuspend cells with 1 mL pipette in the residual buffer (~50 µL).

steps.title: Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue using Collagenase IV and DNAse I.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Collagenase IV + DNAse I digest buffer and pipette gently 5 times with 1 mL pipette.
Incubate at ~20°C (room temp) for 10 mins for terminal ileum (TI) or 15 mins for rectum (R).
Add 5 µL of 0.5M EDTA to quench collagenase IV and pipette gently 5 times with 1 mL pipette.

steps.title: Filtration and Washing
steps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension and wash the cells.

substeps.instruction: Pass digested cell suspension over a 30 µm strainer into a new 15 mL tube.
Pour wash buffer through the strainer into the tube until the volume reaches 10 mL; discard strainer.
Centrifuge at 350 g @ 4°C for 5 min.

steps.title: Red Blood Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Remove red blood cells using ACK lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL ACK lysis buffer and pipette gently 2 times with 1 mL pipette.
Incubate for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Wash Steps
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice to remove lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 8-10 mL wash buffer, centrifuge at 350 g @ 4°C for 5 min, pour off supernatant, and resuspend in residual buffer.
Repeat for a total of 2 washes.
After the second wash, allow all wash buffer to drip off (flicking occasionally) and return tube to ice; approx 50-80 µL residual buffer will pool after 1-2 mins.

steps.title: Final Filtration and Collection
steps.instruction: Perform a final filtration to collect single cells.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend cells using 1 mL pipette.
Pass cells over a 40 µm strainer held over a 6 well plate.
Use 1 mL pipette to collect strained cell suspension from underneath the strainer.
Combine 10 µL trypan blue and 10 µL of cells; transfer 10 µL to a hemocytometer and count using a light microscope (Average quadrant count * 20 = cell count per µL).
Take images for QC. Target: Cell viability >70% and little/no observable cell debris.

steps.title: Optional: Cryopreservation and Thawing
steps.instruction: If immediate processing is not feasible, preserve the biopsies.

substeps.instruction: Add biopsies to cold cryo buffer (90% HI-FBS:10% DMSO) within an hour of collection.
Store cryo tubes in Mr Frosty or Corning Coolcell at -80°C overnight, then transfer to liquid N2 the next day (or keep at -80°C for up to 4 weeks).
On processing day, thaw quickly and wash 2 times with cold 5% heat inactivated FBS in HBSS-/- before continuing with the protocol.
